title: Pregnant Blend 2-Mix Solo #20 (부채꼴 4구역·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: German woman, an adult, in her mid 50s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real pores, real living eyes, 3 drop dangles piercings set with pearls in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of mixed-metal a ring. Full body painted in 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 46% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 1 o'clock, 4 o'clock, 7 o'clock and 9 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is the wedge between the 1 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in French Limoges enamel (a deep cobalt-blue ground with fine white and gold grisaille scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with grisaille scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 7 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with jewel-toned scenework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the wedge between the 7 o'clock ray and the 9 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is the wedge between the 9 o'clock ray and the 1 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
